LanguageData.BurraBite.letterText:
While fishing, {PAWN_nameDef} got too close to the water and was bitten by an angry burra!
The fish escaped.
LanguageData.BurraEscape.letterText:
While reeling in a burra, {PAWN_nameDef} nearly bitten by the thrashing creature.
The fish escaped in the confusion.
LanguageData.DactopusAttack.letterText:
While fishing, {PAWN_nameDef} got too close to the water and was attacked by a leaping dactopus!
The cephalapod squirted it's ink and managed to escape.
LanguageData.DaggertSpine.letterText: While handling a daggert, {PAWN_nameDef} was stung by one of the fish's toxic dorsal spines, causing {PAWN_objective} to drop the fish.
LanguageData.DoshianjellySting.letterText: While handling a doshian jelly, {PAWN_nameDef} was stung by one of the invertebrates's toxic stingers, causing {PAWN_objective} to drop the creature.
LanguageData.FaaEscape.letterText:
While reeling in a faa, {PAWN_nameDef} nearly bitten by the thrashing creature.
The fish escaped in the confusion.
LanguageData.FleekEelEscape.letterText: While attempting to wrangle a fleek eel, {PAWN_nameDef} stumbled and lost the slipper eel in the murky waters.
LanguageData.LaaBite.letterText:
While fishing, {PAWN_nameDef} got too close to the water and was attacked by a the snapping jaws of a laa!
The fish managed to escape..
LanguageData.LaaEscape.letterText: While attempting to reel in a laa, {PAWN_nameDef}'s line tangled, causing {PAWN_objective} to lose the catch.
LanguageData.NyorkBite.letterText:
While fishing, {PAWN_nameDef} got too close to the water and was attacked by a snapping nyork!
The clam managed to escape..
LanguageData.PaddyFrogAttack.letterText: While fishing, {PAWN_nameDef} was suddenly hit by a paddy frog leaping out of the water. This caused {PAWN_objective} to lose {PAWN_possessive} catch.
LanguageData.RayAttack.letterText: While fishing, {PAWN_nameDef} was attacked by a ray and was slashed by its serrated tail fin. The fish escaped.
LanguageData.RayEscape.letterText: While attempting to reel in a ray, {PAWN_nameDef}'s line snapped, causing {PAWN_objective} to lose the catch.
LanguageData.SeeEscape.letterText: While attempting to catch a see, {PAWN_nameDef} fumbled the thin slippery fish, allowing it to escape.
LanguageData.SinkCrabEscape.letterText: While fishing, {PAWN_nameDef} saw the shadow of a massive crustacean beneath the water. The shadow startled {PAWN_nameDef}, causing {PAWN_objective} to lose {PAWN_possessive} catch.
LanguageData.SinkCrabPinch.letterText:
While fishing, {PAWN_nameDef} got too close to the water and was attacked by a the frenzied pincers of a sink crab!
The crab managed to escape..
